heading: Experience Center
intro_paragraphs: Visit our Craft your own Chocolate Bar and experience a world of chocolate.
Let our Chocolate Crafters introduce you to the art of the chocolatier.
Be sure to craft your own chocolate bar and build your own Gift Box.

experience_section.title: Experience Center
paragraphs: Experience our virtual self guided exhibition to learn interesting facts about the History of Chocolate and how it is made.
Be sure to experience our Green Screen Photo Room and choose a selection of backdrops to choose from.

process_section.title: How its Made
process_section.planning_note: We should consider a small intro of why our process makes chocolate “deliciousness” etc
process_section.planning_note_status: User explicitly selected: Start with the seven steps; leave the intro for later.

steps.title: Picking
steps.text: Ripe cocoa pods are cut by hand. Only ready pods are chosen. The tree is protected.

steps.title: Harversting
steps.text: Pods are gathered and carried from the field. Freshness matters. Flavor starts now.

steps.title: Fermentation
steps.text: Beans are removed and left to ferment. Heat builds. Flavor develops.

steps.title: Drying
steps.text: Beans dry in the sun. Moisture fades. The flavor settles.

steps.title: Roasting
steps.text: Heat unlocks cocoa flavor.Aromas deepen. Character forms.

steps.title: Griding and Coaching
steps.text: Beans become chocolate. Time creates smooth texture. Flavor finds balance.

steps.title: Tempering
steps.text: Chocolate is heated and cooled. It gains shine and snap. Ready to enjoy.

tours_section.title: Tours and Classes
paragraphs: Book for a Factory tour or Chocolate Crafting Classes & tasting sessions and let our Chocolate Crafters introduce you to the art of Chocolate Crafting.
